pages.text: The proponent seeks rezoning of 14 hectares of coastal buffer to mixed residential. The submission asserts no net loss of habitat.
Traffic modelling assumes a 12% modal shift to public transport within three years of occupancy, against a current corridor share of 4%.
Stormwater detention is sized to a 1-in-20 year event. The adjoining catchment authority requires 1-in-100 for greenfield release.
The plan nominates a single tertiary referral partner 240km distant and does not identify an alternate for periods when that facility is on bypass.
Staffing assumes a 0.4 FTE locum pool that has not been filled in eleven of the last twelve months.
Cold chain for vaccines relies on one generator with no documented service interval since commissioning.
The escalation matrix names three roles, two of which were abolished in the 2025 restructure.
Two of five panel members did not complete a conflict declaration before scoring commenced. Both declared after the shortlist was set.
The weighting for local content was changed after bids closed, from 10% to 20%, and the change is recorded only in a meeting note.
The agency requests an extension of retention from seven to fifteen years for a dataset containing biometric templates.
The stated purpose is longitudinal research, but no research protocol or ethics approval is attached to the request.
Deletion capability has never been exercised on this dataset and the vendor cannot confirm deletion propagates to backups.
